labctl.notes: keyboard-only (bootOS reads the BIOS keyboard, no pointer at all); no exec channel: type at the $ prompt via 'labctl type' and read the framebuffer. floppy.qcow2 is the ONLY block device and carries the 'golden' vmstate — never delete or replace it; recapture only via checkpoint-guard. Sample screendumps at a fixed instant (stop; screendump; cont): the 9x2 px text caret blinks and is the only thing that ever differs between two samples of the prompt.

render.stationsManifestPrelude:
# bootos (VMID 174) — bootOS, a 512-byte boot-sector OS (Oscar Toledo G., 2019).
#   VERBATIM LAUNCHER: floppy.qcow2 (360K floppy as qcow2, copied from the
#   builder output on first launch) is the ONLY block device; it holds both the
#   filesystem the guest writes (enter/del/format) AND the savevm 'golden'
#   vmstate, so loadvm restores the floppy contents too. PC speaker -> dbus
#   audiodev. Keyboard-only: SH_INPUT_BACKEND=disabled, no pointer device.

museum.lineage: Óscar Toledo G. / from-scratch boot sector
museum.periodBrowser: none — 512 bytes leaves no room for a network stack
museum.blurb: An entire operating system in one 512-byte boot sector — a shell, a filesystem and a hex program loader — plus a floppy of games that are each exactly one sector: chess, a Doom-style raycaster, BASIC, a Flappy Bird, Space Invaders, Tetris.
museum.notes: Live streamhost station. Keyboard-only (bootOS reads the BIOS keyboard, int 16h; there is no pointer device). The guest is the 360K floppy as qcow2, so loadvm restores the directory as well as RAM — anything a visitor `enter`s is gone at the next reset. Type `dir` for the programs, a program's name to run it; most games end with int 0x20 back at the `$` prompt or need Ctrl+Alt+Del (a warm boot returns to bootOS). The type-in demo needs the empty line: `enter` reads hex lines until it gets one.

reset.keyboard: PASS 2026-09-02 on a KVM clone with the production device set: `dir`, `del pi`, and a typed-in 36-byte `enter` program all echoed and ran (framebuffer-read); emu-key-pacing-bisect.py typed a 43-char line intact 10/10 at 10/10, 20/20, 30/30 and 40/40 ms — shipped SH_KEY_MIN_HOLD_MS/GAP_MS=20/20 in station.env.fixture
reset.fixture: bootOS at its `$` prompt straight after an untouched cold boot from the 360K floppy (osall.img as qcow2, the only block device): SeaBIOS's 'Booting from Floppy...' line, the 'bootOS' banner, then `$` with the caret, in the 720x400 VGA text mode (80x25, 9x16 cells). Nothing is typed into the golden; the floppy's directory (19 programs) is inside the snapshot, so loadvm restores what a visitor entered or deleted. Keyboard-only exhibit; PC speaker audio (proven: a typed-in PIT program plays a 1 kHz tone through pcspk-audiodev=snd0).
